images.name: strava-rgg
images.alt: Strava screenshot of Matti Rowe's ride "Red Granite Grinder - Første plass!" (cartoon Gravel God avatar), 6:20 AM on Saturday, October 15, 2022, Town of Stettin, Wisconsin: 148.43 mi, 8:54:42 moving time, 6,017 ft of climbing, 267 W weighted average power, 7,548 kJ, 9:24:38 elapsed, with the course map around Wausau and the elevation profile; KOMs listed below.

images.name: rgg-course-split
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, in his white tee and jorts, rides a black gravel bike along a tree-lined gravel road, focused.
images.note: The real race photo (other riders, his kit, the forest) could not be cleaned without smears, so it is redrawn as a rig scene: he rides a gravel road; rider 730 beside him is missing.

images.name: sram-grx-axs
images.why: Photo of a derailleur box on a garage floor; no Gravel God.

images.name: fred-flinstone
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, in his white tee and jorts, puts a foot down to slow his bike on a gravel road through the trees, wincing.
images.note: The real race photo (other riders, his kit, the forest) could not be cleaned without smears, so it is redrawn as a rig scene: he stops on a tree-lined gravel road; the fallen leaves and snow are missing.

images.name: two-specs
images.alt: A long, wet gravel road through the forest: two tiny riders appear far up the road behind cartoon Gravel God, riding in his white tee and jorts.
images.note: Real race photo: the pasted-head rider is replaced by the rig character riding his own bike in tee and jorts; the real photo, other riders and scenery stay, but his real kit and bike are gone.

images.name: last-billy-goat-1
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, in his white tee and jorts, grinds seated up a steep gravel climb, grimacing.
images.note: The real race photo (other riders, his kit, the forest) could not be cleaned without smears, so it is redrawn as a rig scene: he rides a gravel road; the two riders beside him and the autumn valley are missing.

images.name: rgg-win
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God rides no-handed past a FINISH sign and cones, laughing.
images.note: The real race photo (other riders, his kit, the forest) could not be cleaned without smears, so it is redrawn as a rig scene: he rides a gravel road; the downtown plaza and spectators are missing; a FINISH sign stands in.
